description: This is a Python script for processing utilization logs, generating segments, converting data models, and uploading data to S3, used in a testing or monitoring context within a project.

classes.name: SegmentGenerator
classes.description: Generates test segments from utilization records, focusing on Python command level segments based on time series analysis.

classes.name: UtilizationDbConverter
classes.description: Converts utilization log models into database models suitable for storage and analysis.

classes.name: UploadUtilizationData
classes.description: Main class managing the process of fetching, converting, and uploading utilization data to S3, supporting local and S3 sources.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates time segments from utilization records based on command and time thresholds.

methods.name: _find_continuous_windows
methods.description: Finds continuous time windows in a DataFrame based on a threshold.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts utilization data into metadata and timeseries models.

methods.name: _to_oss_ci_metadata
methods.description: Creates a metadata object for utilization data.

methods.name: _to_oss_ci_timeseries_list
methods.description: Creates a list of timeseries objects from utilization records.

methods.name: _to_oss_ci_time_series
methods.description: Converts a single utilization record into a timeseries object.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Main entry point to process logs, generate segments, convert data, and upload to S3.

methods.name: _upload_utilization_data_to_s3
methods.description: Uploads data to S3 in specified collection and version.

methods.name: get_log_data_from_local
methods.description: Reads and processes utilization log data from a local file.

methods.name: get_log_data_from_s3
methods.description: Downloads and processes utilization log data from S3 artifacts.

methods.name: _process_raw_record
methods.description: Parses a JSON line into a UtilizationRecord, handling errors.

methods.name: _process_utilization_records
methods.description: Processes multiple log lines into valid and invalid utilization records.

methods.name: convert_to_log_models
methods.description: Converts raw log content into metadata and utilization records.
